title: Cristaux (1970). Gribouillis et calculs divers : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
The page is a typed sheet, page 31 of some exposé, filed upside down among Grothendieck's crystal notes. It was apparently reused as scrap paper: the neighbouring pages contain handwritten notes on realizations of motives (Betti, de Rham, crystalline, Hodge, Tate). The typed text is a draft of the codimension-1 case of relative cohomological purity in étale cohomology.

Setting: an S-couple lisse (Y,X), with i: Y -> X a closed immersion of smooth S-schemes of codimension 1 and j: U = X - Y -> X the open complement. Assume Y is cut out by a global equation t = 0. Then t restricts to a unit on U.

Construction: the Kummer sequence 0 -> mu_n -> G_m --n--> G_m -> 0 on U gives a coboundary delta: j_*G_m -> R^1 j_* mu_n. This produces a class delta(t), a section of R^1 j_* mu_n, which is killed by n. It therefore defines a map c_t from (Z/n)_Y to i^* R^1 j_* mu_n. Using the localization triangle, i^*R^1 j_* is identified with R^2 i^! (in degree 2, for coefficients with R^0 i^! = R^1 i^! = 0). So c_t is a map into R^2 i^! mu_n, i.e. into the local cohomology sheaf H^2_Y(X, mu_n). The text announces that c_t is a canonical bijection.

Theorem 3.10 then begins: for the family C of smooth couples of constant codimension, and each n prime to the residue characteristics, there is a unique functorial rule assigning to each S-couple (Y,X) of codimension c a canonical isomorphism Z/n -> H^{2c}_Y(X, mu_n^{⊗c}). The struck line on the page shows this target.

This is the standard relative purity theorem, with the fundamental class built from the Kummer coboundary of a local equation. It serves the construction of Gysin maps, cycle classes and duality in étale cohomology. The terminology 'S-couple lisse' and the reference '(IX.3.2)' for the Kummer sequence match SGA 4, Exposé XVI §3 (Artin, purity for smooth couples), with Exposé IX as the Kummer reference. So the page is most likely a draft or typescript page of that material, not original research on crystals.
errors: Coefficients in (3.9) are written as Z/n where mu_n (or a Tate twist Z/n(1)) is needed. delta(t) lies in R^1 j_* mu_n, so c_t naturally maps (Z/n)_Y to R^2 i^! mu_n, or equivalently Z/n(-1) to R^2 i^! Z/n. The struck line correctly shows H^{2c}_Y(X, mu_n^{⊗c}).
The condition 'n prime to the residue characteristics' is missing from the typed text. It is added by hand in the margin, and it is needed for the Kummer sequence to be exact in the étale topology.
Minor typos: 'un bijection', 'un fonction', 'codimension constant', 'verfons' (corrected to 'verrons').

ideas.modern_name: Relative purity theorem for smooth pairs

deep.surprise_reason: This is a typed draft page of standard SGA 4 material (relative purity for smooth couples via the Kummer sequence), apparently reused as scrap paper. Nothing on it is new or uncredited.
transcription_corrections: The page image is upside down; the text is typewritten, with handwritten insertions.
Handwritten marginal insertion reads 'et chaque n premier aux caractéristiques résiduelles de X'.
'Nous verrons' is typed as 'verfons' and corrected by hand.
The struck final line reads '(Y,X) ... : Z/n -> H^{2c}_Y(X, mu_n...)', with the twist exponent cut off.
